rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold
rules.note: For Hindi text, increase line-height slightly compared to Latin (e.g. leading-loose) due to Devanagari matras. Always load Google Fonts for both Devanagari and Latin.

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY with an INDIAN TWIST

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle SVG noise filter (`mix-blend-mode: multiply`, `opacity: 0.03`) over the base background to remove the 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Use organic, blobbish, overlapping shapes mimicking liquid colors (saffron/teal/purple) in the background. Blur them aggressively (`blur-3xl`).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid `#E8E2D9` on cards to ground them.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Ensure icons map nicely to Hindi concepts (e.g., Compass for दिशा, Brain for विचार).

layouts.general: Mobile-first. Wrap main container in `max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8`.
layouts.header: Sticky nav. Glassmorphism `bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/20`. Include Logo (मेरा व्यक्तित्व), About Link, and EN/HI toggle.
layouts.hero: Bento or split layout. Left: Big Hindi H1 'अपने असली स्वरूप को पहचानें' (Discover your true self), soft subtitle, Pill-shaped primary CTA 'मुफ्त परीक्षण शुरू करें'. Right: Overlapping organic colored shapes.
layouts.test_flow: Single-question-per-screen approach. Huge question text (`text-3xl`). 5-point Likert scale using massive, tappable radio circles. Colors mapping: Green (Agree) to Red (Disagree), but muted (Teal to Saffron). Top bar: Progress bar (`h-2` rounded-full), back button.
layouts.results_page: Dashboard bento grid. Top: Type Code (e.g. INTJ) + Hindi Nickname (e.g. 'वास्तुकार'). Center: Radar chart or 4 horizontal percentage bars. Bottom: Detailed sections (Strengths, Weaknesses, Career) in cards.
layouts.types_grid: CSS Grid `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6`. Each card has a subtle gradient background matching its role (Analysts/Diplomats/Sentinels/Explorers).

components.button: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`). Primary: `bg-peacock_teal text-white hover:bg-[#164E59]`. Secondary: `bg-surface_alt text-text_primary hover:bg-[#E8E2D9]`.
components.card: Rounded corners (`rounded-2xl` or `rounded-3xl`), `bg-white border border-border shadow-sm p-6 sm:p-8`.
components.progress_bar: Use Framer Motion to animate width smoothly on each question change.
components.likert_scale: 5 massive circles. Mobile: vertical stack or wrap. Desktop: horizontal line. Size matters for touch targets.

motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide up (`y: 20, opacity: 0` to `y: 0, opacity: 1`).
motion.question_transition: When Next is clicked, current question slides left (`x: -50, opacity: 0`), new question slides in from right (`x: 50` to `x: 0`).
motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (`-translate-y-1`) and shadow deepens. Buttons scale slightly (`scale: 0.98` on tap).

hero_background.description: Abstract swirls of orange and yellow light to be used lightly with low opacity for hero background

results_header.description: Red yellow and pink abstract painting for results page hero section

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React context or zustand for state management to handle the 60 answers, current question index, and language (EN/HI).
Implement language toggle seamlessly. Store strings in a dictionary object `const i18n = { en: {...}, hi: {...} }`.
For the 60 questions, generate a realistic array of 60 MBTI-style questions in both Hindi and English. Group them by dimensions (E/I, S/N, T/F, J/P).
Implement autosave: Save current answers and question index to `localStorage` on every selection. Load on mount.
Do NOT use HTML inputs for the Likert scale; build custom tappable divs with Framer Motion for selection feedback.
For the Results chart, use Recharts for a clean horizontal bar chart showing percentages of the 4 traits.
Create 16 unique dummy profiles (nickname in Hindi + English, description) for the results generation logic.
Use framer-motion for smooth transitions between questions. This is critical for the UX.
Ensure the Hindi text uses the loaded Devanagari web font correctly, and fallback to `sans-serif` if it fails.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over colored backgrounds meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.touch_targets: All Likert options and buttons must be at least 48x48px for mobile users.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Do not use complete transparent background in header or overlays.
